title: Chapter 434 Defeat Zhang Changfan
content:
Chapter 434 Defeat Zhang Changfan

It’s good to be young. Thinking about it, I was so glorious and full of spirit.

However, since I was taught by the palace master some time ago, I seemed to have lived a second spring and became energetic again.

Thinking of this, Mo Chou's lips raised again, outlining that confident smile.

Target, deserted city.

.........

"I finally met someone who can fight."

Bai Xu stared at the young man in the distance, his eyes as if he was torched.

At this moment, the young man opposite was slightly panting, and his eyes were filled with fear when he looked at Bai Xu.

Bai Xu's attack was too sharp, and he had to choose to defend, and he could not find any opportunity to attack.

What made him even more uncomfortable was that Bai Xu directly gave up his defense and attacked with all his strength.

Until now, I not only consumed a lot of physical strength, but also did not pose any threat to Bai Xu.

On the other hand, Bai Xu, as the Heavenly Demon Clan, his physical strength is naturally far superior to that of the human race. When he competes with physical strength, he is not Bai Xu's opponent, and when he competes with strength, he is not Bai Xu's opponent.

Being trapped in such a difficult situation, Zhang Changfan began to force himself to think calmly.

My only advantage is realm.

He is in the realm of immortality, and his energy in his body must be higher than that in Bai Xu, so try to avoid fighting with Bai Xu and he has a chance.

Thinking of this, Zhang Changfan closed his eyes slightly and fell into a special state.

At this moment, Bai Xu shrugged and chuckled, "The warm-up is over. If you still can't show your decent skills, then be honest and ready to get out."

Bai Xu, who had won consecutive victories, was like an extremely sharp blade at this moment, unstoppable.

At this time, Zhang Changfan slowly opened his eyes and looked at Bai Xu.

The next moment, a bright white light began to appear around Zhang Changfan. As time passed, the white light became more and more intense. Bai Xu smelled something wrong and hurriedly took action.

Buzz —

Suddenly, Bai Xu rushed to Zhang Changfan and punched him.

But the white light around Zhang Changfan quickly condensed together like a spirit, turned into a ball, blocking Zhang Changfan's body.

The next moment, Bai Xu felt as if he had punched the cotton, and there was no power leaking out.

"Something is a bit."

Bai Xu murmured.

But Zhang Changfan looked at Bai Xu and whispered: "This is not as simple as something."

The next moment, the white light suddenly burst out, and a powerful force suddenly poured on Bai Xu.

boom!

With a loud bang, Bai Xu was knocked away to the distance, looking quite embarrassed.

"This is?!"

Bai Xu was shocked. This power was the power of the punch he just now. The white light not only absorbed his own power, but also attacked him when he turned around.

Can attack or defend.

There is something really happening now.

Bai Xu's face was slightly dark, and at this time, the white light around Zhang Changfan was still increasing.

Regardless of whether Zhang Changfan's move can be stacked all the time, he must fight quickly.

Bai Xu took a deep breath, and his hands suddenly showed a sharp claw.

With a bang.

Bai Xu rushed towards Zhang Changfan and stabbed Zhang Changfan with his sharp claws.

"Condensation!"

Seeing this, Zhang Changfan shouted loudly, and a thick ball of light blocked in front of him.

Immediately afterwards, the long sharp claws pierced into the light ball, and it instantly solidified, making Bai Xu unable to pull out for a short time.

How could Zhang Changfan let this go if he was such a good opportunity?

In an instant, the dense white light gradually submerged Bai Xu. Zhang Changfan quickly retreated and said softly: "Explode!"

Boom!

With a loud bang, the white light exploded.

The huge shock wave made Zhang Changfan retreat violently.

He didn't even retreat to a safe distance just now, but directly detonated the light source, just to prevent Bai Xu from having time to break free.

At this time, Zhang Changfan had a sharp look and stared at the front.

Of course, he would not be stupid enough to think that he could kill Bai Xu in this way.

Bai Xu is a powerful beast, and he is definitely a thick skin and flesh. He must slowly take care of it.

Sure enough, as the smoke of gunpowder dissipated, a ferocious giant white tiger appeared in Zhang Changfan's vision, and the fierce aura made Zhang Changfan's breathing stagnate.

Is this the essence of the White Tiger?

It's really scary.

Finally, for the first time since Bai Xu rushed to the list, someone was able to force him out of his body.

Zhang Changfan is also one of the few who are powerful on the list.

Bai Xu looked at Zhang Changfan in the distance for a moment, and the evil aura emitted from his body suddenly condensed. Bai Xu's pupils shrank sharply, and the terrifying spiritual power quickly hit Zhang Changfan like a bullet.

call out--

The space fluctuated, and Zhang Changfan looked shocked, but it was too late.

With a buzzing sound, Zhang Changfan's head hurts sharply and his eyes are covered with bloodshot. He never expected that Bai Xu would have such a strange trick that was beyond defense.

But even so, the white light source around Zhang Changfan did not stop, but protected Zhang Changfan tightly.

Sure enough, Bai Xu took this opportunity to raid Zhang Changfan.

I thought that Bai Xuhua became the main body and his huge body would affect his speed, but Bai Xu's speed not only did not decrease, but also improved.

The white tiger's body suddenly appeared beside Zhang Changfan like a ghost.

Bang!

With a palm slapped out, Zhang Changfan flew out immediately.

Then, before Zhang Changfan could react, Bai Xu made another sprint.

Bang!

This time, it was Bai Xu who flew out.

Zhang Changfan's eyes were blood-red, and he struggled to get up, looking at Bai Xu in the distance and shouted, "Let you see, what is the realm of immortality!"

Suddenly, the white light shone as bright as the sun, and the entire martial arts field was suddenly covered with a piece of white light, as if it was covered with snow.

A powerful suppression suppressed Bai Xu, who had not yet stood up.

Bai Xu snorted coldly about this.

The next moment, a fierce aura emerged, and a black flame suddenly ignited on Bai Xu's body.

"Shura Purgatory!"

The black air rolled, covering the white light. Zhang Changfan was shocked and immediately suffered a backlash.

A mouthful of essence and blood spurted out, and Zhang Changfan subconsciously blocked his arms in front of him.

boom!

Bai Xu instantly appeared in front of Zhang Changfan and clawed down.

Puchi!

Zhang Changfan's arms were broken, and his flesh and blood were ferocious.

At this point, Zhang Changfan lost.

But this was not over yet. Looking at Zhang Changfan lying on the ground, blood flowing and no longer had the strength to fight back, Bai Xu gasped and walked up to him.

laugh!

The sharp claws pierced into Zhang Changfan's chest, and the fierce aura instantly erased his vitality.

Zhang Changfan is dead.

Bai Xu stopped, turned back into a human form, staggered, and immediately sat on the ground.

After all, he is better at it.

It seems that not all the people on the list are mediocre people now.

By the way, I have already won many titles now.

And just as he was thinking about it, a prompt sound suddenly rang out.

"Congratulations, you are the first genius list to top the list, and you are specially distributed to you with encouragement awards."

The light source emerged, and Bai Xu was stunned.
